user.title: HESCOM account
user.description: Enter the consumer account number printed on your HESCOM bill, for example 1234567890. The integration only reads the data the consumer portal already shows you.

error.invalid_account: The account number must contain digits only.
error.invalid_auth: HESCOM rejected the request signature. Try again in a few minutes.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach hescom.co.in. Check your connection and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This HESCOM account is already configured.

init.title: HESCOM refresh settings
init.description: Control how often the portal is polled and whether bill PDFs are saved to /config/www/hescom.

data.bill_watch_interval: Refresh interval while a bill is expected
data.bill_delay_interval: Refresh interval when the bill is late
data.bill_watch_after_days: Start watching this many days after the meter read
data.bill_watch_max_days: Length of the expected billing window

data_description.scan_interval: Used when no bill is expected and nothing is due.
data_description.bill_watch_interval: Faster cadence inside the expected billing window, so a new bill is noticed quickly.
data_description.bill_delay_interval: Cadence once the expected window has passed but the bill still has not appeared.
data_description.bill_watch_after_days: Counted from the last meter reading date reported by HESCOM.
data_description.bill_watch_max_days: How long after the watch start date a new bill is still considered on time.
data_description.archive_pdfs: Archived PDFs are also served at /local/hescom/<bill id>.pdf.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Fetch the latest HESCOM data now instead of waiting for the next scheduled refresh.

entry_id.name: Account
entry_id.description: Limit the refresh to one configured HESCOM account. Leave empty to refresh every account.
